title: CorpusBiblioExtractor: exhaustive biblioshiny sweeps and UI-metadata extraction from a BibTeX corpus
description:
R package that drives bibliometrix directly to run the full combinatorial sweep of biblioshiny's "Main Configuration" over a bibliographic corpus, materialises every output asset (tables, figures, interactive networks and Sankeys, Pajek nets) and renders the whole run in a self-contained HTML viewer. It also reads biblioshiny's UI metadata straight from source with an AST-based extractor.

A complete run over a Web of Science corpus is published at https://migueldiazmacedo.com/demo-corpus-extractor/. The method is described in Bibliometría reproducible: automatizar el análisis de science mapping en una sola corrida.
